best_window: Early morning to late morning before wind builds
report_text:
The model expects 10-14 ft of visibility, resulting in a C grade. Conditions are moderately favorable overall, but the algorithm is seeing enough swell energy and surface movement to prevent a clearer B-grade forecast.

The rising tide is a favorable signal. As water moves toward the next high tide at 11:17 PM, cleaner offshore water may move into La Jolla and support improving visibility.

Overall, the forecast remains diveable, but clarity may vary by location and could be worse around shallow reefs, sandy bottoms and areas exposed to surge.
